label: Identical structures
definition: Two clusters encode the exact same structure including stereochemistry, charge, and tautomeric form.

label: Identical structures with undetermined charge
definition: Structures are equivalent but at least one member lacks explicit charge annotation; downstream tools should harmonize charge before comparison.

label: Protomers
definition: A conjugate acid/base pair that differ only by the position of one or more protons (protomeric relationship).

label: Indistinguishable structures
definition: Input data are insufficient to discriminate stereochemistry, so structures are treated as indistinguishable until clarified.

label: Enantiomers
definition: Nonsuperimposable mirror-image stereoisomers with opposite chiral configurations at all stereogenic centers.

label: Diastereomers
definition: Stereoisomers that are not related as mirror images and differ at one or more (but not all) stereogenic centers.

label: Stereo-resolution pairs
definition: A planar (racemic or unresolved) representation paired with a resolved stereochemical form of the same compound.

label: Unclassified
definition: Relationship exists but StereoMapper could not determine a confident class.

label: Unresolved
definition: Processing completed but ambiguity prevented StereoMapper from distinguishing between multiple plausible classes.
